title: Digital twins forecast individual immune trajectories
summary: personalized single-cell digital twins forecast individual immune trajectories and outperform existing methods on external and repeated-vaccination data.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: personalized single-cell digital twins forecast individual immune trajectories and outperform existing methods on external and repeated-vaccination data.
evidence.unknown: Forecast performance was evaluated on external and repeated-vaccination data; prospective clinical benefit was not established.
evidence.ai_role: Personalizes a shared virtual-cell model with each person’s longitudinal immune-cell observations and history to forecast that person’s future immune-cell states.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
